title: Coding Interview University reveals a #CodingInterviewUniversity #AmazonCareer #ComputerScience
description:
Coding Interview University provided a comprehensive self-study roadmap that helped one individual go from minimal computer science knowledge to securing a job at Amazon. The free GitHub resource covers core computer science topics including data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, databases, and system design, effectively replicating a traditional CS degree curriculum.

Created as a personal preparation tool for software engineering interviews, the repository condenses four years of academic knowledge into a structured and accessible format. Its widespread popularity reflects a growing trend in self-directed learning and the democratization of tech education, enabling candidates to bypass formal degrees.

This approach highlights the shifting landscape in tech hiring, where skills and knowledge demonstrated through self-study and practical mastery can lead to top-tier opportunities. The resource serves as a valuable blueprint for aspiring developers aiming to break into competitive engineering roles without traditional educational pathways.
